notes.title: Try Haunted Memories: The Return free demo during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Uncover the secrets of Green Park in our upcoming game: Haunted Memories: The Return.

[previewyoutube=iCdFcvbc7Zs;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iCdFcvbc7Zs[/previewyoutube]

Delve deep into the mysteries shrouding this cursed place, piecing together enigmatic clues, and capturing eerie photographs that will shed light on its haunting past.

Try the free demo of Haunted Memories: The Return during Steam Next Fest!
